lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal spot rows, creating a staggered grid-like arrangement of high-contrast nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features running horizontally across the dorsal and mid-flank, defined by sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradients.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of high-luminance spots is visible on the distal and leading surfaces of the right pectoral fin.
